# SURGE Staffing

> > SURGE Staffing is a national leader in workforce solutions, connecting job seekers with employers through staffing services, mobile technology, and AI-powered matching across 200+ locations in 24 states.

SURGE Staffing operates as a comprehensive staffing platform offering flexible, full-time, and direct-hire placements alongside vendor management systems, payroll services, and real-time workforce analytics. The company serves both job seekers and employers through its mySurge mobile app, web portal, and extensive branch network.

## Job Search & Application

- [Search and Apply for Jobs | Surge Staffing | National Job Openings](https://surgestaffing.com/jobsearch): Job search platform with listings across Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia and beyond
- [SurgeStaffing - Apply Now](https://surgestaffing.com/apply-now): Job application portal via eportal.surgejobs.com for staffing recruitment
- [SURGE Staffing | How to Apply](https://surgestaffing.com/how-to-apply): Step-by-step guide to apply for jobs using SURGE Staffing and mySurge
- [Discover Jobs Fast with the mySurge App! | Surge Staffing](https://surgestaffing.com/app): mySurge mobile app for streamlined job search and onboarding

## Staffing Services & Solutions

- [Full-Time Staffing | SURGE](https://surgestaffing.com/fullTimeStaffing): Full-time and temp-to-hire workforce solutions and recruitment
- [Full-Time Staffing | SURGE](https://surgestaffing.com/flexibleStaffing): Full-time and flexible staffing solutions with candidate vetting
- [Full-Time Staffing | SURGE](https://surgestaffing.com/directhire): Direct hire full-time staffing and permanent workforce solutions
- [Place Order | SurgeStaffing](https://surgestaffing.com/place-staffing-order): Order form for businesses to request staffing services and talent
- [SurgeVMS | Vendor Management System for Workforce Solutions](https://surgestaffing.com/vms): SurgeVMS platform for vendor management, onboarding, and contingent workforce
